craft_notes: Sthāyin: utsāha at willed-measure — tenderness (vatsa) inside rigor. Teeming fancy arisen; purified-trace holding. Rejected: (a) fancy→thought → killed: fancy keeps play. Read aloud: HIS-own-MOST MA-king … PUR-i-fied-TRACE HOLD-ing TO-that.

lines: His ownmost making — this-and-that teeming fancy —
Śaiva forth-going arisen — purified trace holding to that.
